description: Purchase used 60% for the business: only the s.61 proportion of the VAT is deductible
notes: VATCA 2010 s.59(2) allows the deduction in so far as the cost is used for taxable supplies; a cost used for both deductible and non-deductible purposes is a dual-use input (s.61(1)), deductible only in the proportion of tax deductible (s.61(2), the s.61(4) turnover ratio by default). The line carries a 60% business-use share; the share is flagged, never silently assumed to be 100.
